age.evidence: Adult male Sprague-Dawley rats (Charles River, Quebec) weighing 280-320 g at the beginning of each study

dosing.evidence: DOI (Sigma) was dissolved in saline and injected SC 30 min before testing; DOI (0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.6 mg/kg, SC; n = 10)

group_housing.evidence: Rats were housed individually in a temperature-controlled and humidity-controlled room

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12h light/dark cycle (lights on at 8:00 a.m.). All training and testing were conducted during the light phase.

assays.assay_description: 40-min sessions in Med Associates operant chambers with two retractable levers. Pressing the active (CRf) lever delivered a compound visual+auditory CS (previously paired with water during 10 Pavlovian conditioning sessions) on a RR2 schedule; pressing the inactive (NCRf) lever had no consequence. Tested alone and in combination with methylphenidate.

application_type.evidence: DOI (Sigma) was dissolved in saline and injected SC 30 min before testing

setup_habituation.evidence: In the habituation phase, subjects were placed in the chambers with the house light on and approximately 2 ml of water in the dish.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the boxes with both levers present

food_restriction.evidence: Food not present in the operant chamber during testing; water restriction described but not food

water_restriction.evidence: Throughout these experiments, rats were allowed access to water for 2 h per day between 2 and 4 p.m.

time_to_assay.evidence: DOI ... injected SC 30 min before testing

outcomes.summary: DOI dose-dependently reduced responding for the conditioned reinforcer; 0.3 and 0.6 mg/kg DOI reduced CRf lever pressing without affecting the inactive lever. The effect was blocked by M100907, indicating a 5-HT2A receptor-mediated action. DOI also attenuated the methylphenidate-induced enhancement of CRf responding.
outcomes.statistics: F(3,27) = 7.35, p < 0.001; dose × lever interaction F(3,27) = 4.76, p < 0.01; DOI × methylphenidate × lever interaction F(1,9) = 5.13, p < 0.05
outcomes.evidence: For DOI, the main effect of dose [F 3,27 = 7.35, p < 0.001] and the dose × lever interaction [F 3,27 = 4.76, p < 0.01] were significant; 0.3 and 0.6 mg/kg DOI reduced responding on the CRf lever only

B1_num_measures.evidence: responses on the CRf lever and responses on the NCRf (inactive) lever

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as total responses over the 40-min session

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested alone in operant chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: Task requires Pavlovian conditioning of the CS-US association and instrumental learning

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Med Associates operant chambers (lever press detection, SCORE-0 list)

E1_environment_type.evidence: standard operant conditioning chambers (Med Associates, VT)

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter present in operant chamber

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard operant chamber floor, no bedding mentioned

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus

E6_spatial.evidence: Single operant chamber compartment with levers and magazine

E8_food_water.evidence: no water was delivered during the CRf test session

D1_continuity.evidence: every animal was tested with all doses of the specific drug being examined ... Drug tests were separated by at least 72 h

D2_session_duration.evidence: drug testing was conducted in 40-min sessions

D3_recording_days.evidence: four DOI dose conditions tested with Latin square; drug tests separated by at least 72 h

D4_baseline.evidence: vehicle condition included in within-subjects Latin square design; initial test session prior to drug testing to establish lever sampling

assays.assay_description: 40-min sessions in the same operant chambers with only the right lever extended; responses delivered 0.1 ml of water on a RR2 schedule. Used to test whether drug effects on CRf responding were specific or generalized to primary reinforcement.

application_type.evidence: DOI ... injected SC 30 min before testing

setup_habituation.evidence: Responding for water was acquired rapidly and was stable after five to seven sessions (acquisition sessions prior to drug testing)

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the test chambers for daily 40-min sessions

food_restriction.evidence: Food not present in chamber during session

water_restriction.evidence: rats were allowed access to water for 2 h per day between 2 and 4 p.m.

time_to_assay.evidence: DOI injected SC 30 min before testing

outcomes.summary: DOI did not significantly alter responding for water relative to vehicle at any dose tested (0.1, 0.3, 0.6 mg/kg), indicating the suppression of CRf responding was not due to a generalized motor or motivational deficit.
outcomes.evidence: Dunnett's test showed that none of the doses of DOI altered responding when compared to the vehicle condition (Fig. 3d).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Only responses on the water-delivering lever recorded (single active lever)

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour

B6_cognitive.evidence: Task requires learning the lever-water association

E8_food_water.evidence: responses on the right lever delivered 0.1 ml of water according to a RR2 schedule

D1_continuity.evidence: doses tested according to a Latin square design with sessions separated by ≥72 h

D3_recording_days.evidence: Four DOI conditions (vehicle + 3 doses) tested on separate days

D4_baseline.evidence: Vehicle session included in within-subjects Latin square

judge_notes: Only DOI qualifies as a psychedelic compound under the rubric; 8-OH-DPAT, WAY100635, M100907, Ro60-0175, SB242084, and methylphenidate are non-psychedelic 5-HT/DA ligands and are not listed as separate assays' psychedelic exposures — but the CRf and water-reinforcement assays still include DOI testing and are scored.

Two assays retained: (1) Responding for Conditioned Reinforcement (merges basal CRf testing, methylphenidate-combination testing, and the explicitly-unpaired CS control, all using the same paradigm); (2) Responding for Water (separate paradigm using same apparatus but primary reinforcement).
B1 for CRf scored 1 (2-3 measures: CRf lever and NCRf lever responses) following gptoss; glm agreed on category. Water assay scored 0 (only active lever measured, inactive lever retracted).
E8 differs between assays: CRf session delivers only CS (no water), so 0; water assay delivers water as reinforcer, so 1.
D4 baseline scored 1: vehicle session within Latin square serves as within-subject baseline; reasonable interpretation though confidence reduced to medium.

Food restriction marked 'during' (food not in apparatus); water restriction marked 'before' for CRf (chronic 2h/day access regime preceding test) — this is the more accurate reading per rubric since rats were water-restricted prior to testing.
